title: South Korean FuriosaAI Unveils Third-Generation AI Inference Accelerator: 32x Improvement in Computing Power and Memory Bandwidth

content_html:
Korean AI semiconductor startup FuriosaAI announced the technical details of its third-generation AI inference accelerator yesterday.

The accelerator was developed in collaboration with Broadcom, featuring two "mask limit-level" 2nm computing dies, one independent I/O die, 12 HBM4(E) memory stacks each with 48GB capacity, and using a SUE full interconnection topology within the rack, supporting PCIe Gen7.

FuriosaAI stated that the physical size of the chip is about eight times that of the second-generation chip (RGND); the computing power can reach 32 PFLOPS, 32 times that of RGND; the HBM memory capacity reaches 576GB, 12 times that of RGND; and the HBM memory bandwidth reaches 48TB/s, also 32 times that of RGND.
